verdict.rationale: Every MCP item in the pack describes Zapier acting as an MCP server: AI clients like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor connect to Zapier MCP to use Zapier's app actions. Nothing shows Zapier, such as Zapier Agents or Zaps, acting as a client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools. Tool bundles only share lists of Zapier's own tools between Zapier MCP servers, so server-side evidence earns no credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
